id./param/scenario/cs/b_010_cs_010.pack|cs_: "Well, well, {var:1}. Can't you sleep?
"Ah. You've been fighting with Gemma, haven't you?
"She hit me on the head! I was just messing around... I only drew eyebrows on Sandy!
"Hee hee. Ha ha ha.
"It's not funny! Look, I've got a huge lump!!
"And did you hit her back?
"Listen, {var:1}. This will happen again. So remember what I tell you now.
"No matter how upsetting things get, hitting back is not the right thing to do.
"I want to be friends with Gemma again. Mum, what should I do?
"First, talk to her. Ask what she felt, and why she did it. Then you'll start to understand her.
"After that it's easy. Smile, and shake her hand.
"...Okay. I get it.
"That's my boy. Now, time for bed.
"Yes, that's my boy. Now, time for bed.
"Night-night, Mum.
"Night, {var:1}. Don't be afraid of anything. Everything will be better in the morning.
"Goodnight, sleep tight, child of Yggdrasil. A quiet, quiet night has come.
...Have you found the Luminary?
No, Master. We have searched the whole world, but there is no sign of the Luminary.
...So he is dead. The Luminary is gone...
This world is mine!!
